Welcome to my website! My name is Gabriela Palomo and I am a carnivore ecologist from Guatemala (Central America). I am currently an Assistant Professor at Universidad del Valle de Guatemala. I got my PhD degree from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln with [Drew Tyre](https://www.linkedin.com/in/drew-tyre/). Previously,  I did a post doc in the US at the University of Maryland with [Dr Travis Gallo](https://urbanxnaturelab.com/) and a post doc at Kansas University with [Dr Adam Ahlers](https://hnr.k-state.edu/about/people/faculty/ahlers-adam/). I use this website to keep my blog called [My Digital Notebook](blog.html) and my data visualization portfolio. I also include here information on how to contact me.

**If you would like me to review a paper please email me here:** 

[gabriella.palomo@gmail.com](mailto:gabriella.palomo@gmail.com)

## News

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| tbl-colwidths: [25, 75]
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(kableExtra)


news_tbl <- readr::read_csv("docs/news.csv", 
                            col_types = cols(
                              Date = col_date(format = "%m/%d/%Y"), 
                              Text = col_character(), 
                              Link = col_character()
                            )) |> 
  mutate(Date = format(Date, "%B %d, %Y"),
         News = htmltools::htmlEscape(Text),
         News = if_else(
           !is.na(Link) & nzchar(Link),
           glue('<a href="{Link}" target="_blank">{Text}</a>'),
           Text)) |> 
  arrange(desc(Date)) |> 
  select(Date, News) |> 
  slice_head(n=5)

news_tbl |> 
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE) |> 
  column_spec(1, width = "20em") |> 
  column_spec(2, width = "80em") |> 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, extra_css = "font-weight: 700 !important;")|> 
  kable_styling()

```
